text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines dense retrieval with language model generation.
BM25 is a sparse bag-of-words retrieval function based on term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Dense retrieval encodes queries and documents into vector embeddings and retrieves by cosine similarity.
Hybrid retrieval fuses sparse and dense signals using Reciprocal Rank Fusion or learned weights.
Rerankers use cross-encoder models to rescore candidate documents for improved precision.
NDCG@10 measures the ranking quality of the top-10 retrieved documents weighted by relevance grade.
Recall@K measures the fraction of relevant documents found in the top-K retrieved results.
A retrieval pipeline consists of one or more stages: retriever, optional reranker, optional filter.
